product_one_liner.value: Orange Logic provides a content orchestration platform with digital and media asset management that helps large brands, archives, and government agencies manage, govern, and orchestrate content at scale.
product_one_liner.notes: The About page describes the content orchestration platform, its DAM and MAM capabilities, and its audience of large brands, archives, and government agencies. Source: https://www.orangelogic.com/about

pricing_page.notes: No company pricing page is linked in the homepage navigation or footer, and the tested pricing URL did not yield a page. Third-party pricing directory listings are not treated as a company-site pricing page. Source: https://www.orangelogic.com/

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The homepage explicitly labels Lionsgate as a customer and links an Instacart customer story. Source: https://www.orangelogic.com/ | named_customers.0: The Lionsgate section explicitly says Customer Since 2024. Source: https://www.orangelogic.com/ | named_customers.1: The homepage names Instacart and links its customer case study. Source: https://www.orangelogic.com/

employee_band.notes: The profile reports 278 employees, which falls in the requested 201-500 band; profile-associated headcount may differ from payroll headcount. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/orange-logic

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile explicitly identifies Irvine, California as headquarters. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/320369 | hq_country: The company profile identifies its country as United States. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/orange-logic

founded_year.notes: The company profile explicitly states Founded 1998. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/320369

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index presents DAM strategy, product, marketing, workflow, and implementation content rather than two engineer-authored accounts of how Orange Logic is built. Source: https://www.orangelogic.com/blog

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal documents REST APIs and contains multiple sections and linked articles, including API versioning, DataTable APIs, and webhooks. Source: https://developer.orangelogic.com/reference/about

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists Applied AI Product Engineer, and its posting provides an application option. Sources: https://www.orangelogic.com/about/careers and https://www.orangelogic.com/jobs/global-applied-ai-product-engineer-orange-logic

model_provider.notes: Orange Logic explicitly identifies NVIDIA Nemotron open models for its Agent Studio capabilities. Source: https://www.orangelogic.com/dam-blog/orange-logic-brings-nvidia-nemotron-to-agent-studio-advancing-governed-ai-agents-for-enterprise-content

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The homepage publicly claims all four listed standards; these are reported as company claims, not independently verified certifications. Source: https://www.orangelogic.com/ | compliance_certs.0: SOC 2 is explicitly claimed on https://www.orangelogic.com/. | compliance_certs.1: ISO 27001 is explicitly claimed on https://www.orangelogic.com/. | compliance_certs.2: HIPAA is explicitly claimed on https://www.orangelogic.com/. | compliance_certs.3: GDPR is explicitly claimed on https://www.orangelogic.com/.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A public Account Executive posting remains accessible with application links and an application section, although it was not shown in the current careers index. Source: https://www.orangelogic.com/jobs/account-executive

launched_6mo.notes: The September 8, 2026 announcement introduces NVIDIA Nemotron capabilities in Agent Studio, a substantive AI feature within the preceding six months. Source: https://www.orangelogic.com/dam-blog/orange-logic-brings-nvidia-nemotron-to-agent-studio-advancing-governed-ai-agents-for-enterprise-content
